mapper.select: SELECT CODE_GRP, CODE_ID, CODE_NM, SORT_ORDR, USE_AT FROM OPS_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} AND USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDR

SELECT CODE_GRP, CODE_ID, CODE_NM, SORT_ORDR, USE_AT FROM OPS_CODE WHERE 1 = 1
AND CODE_GRP = #{searchCondition}
AND (CODE_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR CODE_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
ORDER BY CODE_GRP, SORT_ORDR OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CODE (CODE_GRP, CODE_ID, CODE_NM, SORT_ORDR, USE_AT) VALUES (#{codeGrp}, #{codeId}, #{codeNm}, #{sortOrdr}, #{useAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OPS_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} AND CODE_ID = #{codeId}
